stories.summary: China has stretched older DUV lithography far further than expected, using multiple patterning to approach 5nm-class without EUV. But experts say the trade-offs in cost, yield, and die size mean further advancements are unlikely to be economically viable.

stories.title: Bambu Lab teases its mysterious H3C tool changer 3D printer
stories.summary: Bambu Lab’s long-awaited tool changer H3C launches Nov. 3, 2026.

stories.title: Illegal Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs found inside state-owned China Telecom's network
stories.summary: A security firm has been able to identify 32 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 AI chips running inside a China Telecom network, but it's unclear where the export-barred components are physically located.

stories.title: FCC issues first bans under new chip-level rule
stories.summary: FCC bans a dashcam and wireless video transmitter produced by HiSilicon, a subsidiary of Huawei for containing an AI chip that advertises face detection algorithms.

stories.title: Deepseek's latest AI model is smarter than ever, but its low running costs come at a price
stories.summary: Deepseek 4.1 Flash 1017 drives cost-per-task further down still — open-weight model is fit for agentic workloads and exceedingly cheap to run

stories.title: UK proposes 14-year prison sentences for undersea cable saboteurs amid Russian trawler threats
stories.summary: The UK government has outlined plans for new powers and criminal offenses to help protect undersea cables in UK waters amid fears of Russian interference.

stories.title: US banks scramble to restrict AI agent activity
stories.summary: Several U.S. banks are blocking AI agents from making transactions on their platforms. They fear that those agents could go rogue and there's no way to tell if the moves they make are legitimate or not.

stories.title: Consultant comes clean for sparking worldwide panic by accidentally breaking the PHP vulnerability embargo
stories.summary: The user said that they only wanted to alert others about the importance of the upcoming CVE releases and weren't told about the embargo.

stories.title: Claude and Grok among AI agents used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions
stories.summary: Claude and Grok are among the AI agents that are being used to automate attacks on Latin American institutions, including banks and payment apps, by a group calling themselves CyberCartel.

stories.title: China-aligned hackers deploy AI agents in massive ConnectWise supply chain attack
stories.summary: Microsoft says China-aligned Storm-0940 used the ARTEX AI agent framework in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.

stories.title: Save $450 on this 4K gaming PC with an RTX 5070 Ti and 9800X3D, now $2,549.99
stories.summary: You can save $450 on this 4K-capable gaming machine from Newegg's ABS brand, featuring the powerful RTX 5070 Ti, AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D, 32GB DDR5, and a 2TB SSD for $2,549.99.

stories.title: Wolves roam into Finnish villages after Google destroys 1,300 acres of forest for AI data centers
stories.summary: Wolves, who used to live in the forests recently cleared for Google data center development, are now roaming into Finnish villages nearby.

stories.title: Extremely rare and 'previously undocumented' Pokémon Red prototype cartridge surfaces at auction, starting at $25,000
stories.summary: A rare prototype cartridge of Pokémon Red for the Nintendo Game Boy is on sale, with one $25,000 bid so far.
